free_tier_limits: No official free tier policy; unofficial public user endpoints have no published developer tier or paid plan
description: Duolingo is a popular language-learning platform. There is no known official public developer API for third-party apps; community reverse-engineered endpoints and unofficial wrappers exist for user progress, streak, and vocabulary data.
resolution_notes: base_url: Verifier B partly right — no official developer API, but the live reverse-engineered host used by community clients is https://www.duolingo.com (versioned paths like /2017-06-30/); keep that as the practical base_url. docs_url: Verifier B correct — product homepage is not API docs; set docs_url null (no official public developer documentation found as of 2026). free_tier: Verifier B correct — free_tier:false misframes absence of an official API product as paid-only; unofficial public user endpoints require no developer payment; free_tier true. free_tier_limits: Verifier B correct — "no free tier" is wrong framing; use not-applicable wording. Evidence: https://www.duolingo.com (product site, no developer portal), community usage of /2017-06-30/users endpoints.
